priorities.heading: BUILD A NEW ECONOMY THAT MEETS OUR NEEDS
priorities.quote: Most workers agree, we need a radical reconstruction of the economy: and that begins by seizing the 100 biggest corporations –including the six, like Kroger and Procter & Gamble, headquartered right here in Ohio –(just 0.0007% of businesses) and transforming them into public property, democratically controlled by the workers themselves.

priorities.heading: BUILD A DEMOCRACY FOR THE WORKING CLASS – END THE DICTATORSHIP OF THE RICH
priorities.quote: We must build a new system of government where power is directly exercised by workers through their unions, neighborhood assemblies, and community organizations—a true democracy from the bottom up.

priorities.heading: END THE WAR ON BLACK AMERICA!
priorities.quote: This begins with the full payment of reparations to Black Americans for slavery and Jim Crow dictatorship.

cost-of-living.heading: BUILD A NEW ECONOMY THAT MEETS OUR NEEDS
cost-of-living.quote: This will put Ohio’s proud union labor back to work at a living wage, manufacturing the renewable energy systems, transit and housing materials needed to slash emissions and rebuild America.

housing.heading: BUILD A NEW ECONOMY THAT MEETS OUR NEEDS
housing.quote: This means enacting a national rent cap so no one pays more than 20% of their income on housing, and banning evictions.

health-care.heading: BUILD A NEW ECONOMY THAT MEETS OUR NEEDS
health-care.quote: It means establishing a universal, single-payer healthcare system, free at the point of use.

immigration.heading: FIGHT THE REAL ENEMIES! THE ONLY DANGEROUS MINORITY IS THE BILLIONAIRE CLASS
immigration.quote: That means abolishing ICE, ending all raids and deportations, shutting down the detention camps, and establishing a clear path to citizenship.

foreign-policy.heading: STOP THE FOREVER WARS – END THE US WAR MACHINE
foreign-policy.quote: We will fight to slash the Pentagon budget by 90%.

climate-energy.heading: SAVE THE PLANET FROM CAPITALISM- ONLY SOCIALISM CAN SOLVE THE CLIMATE CRISIS
climate-energy.quote: Ohio can be at the forefront of the green revolution—building out public transit systems connecting our cities; reorganizing our agricultural production sustainably; retooling our manufacturing expertise for renewable technology.

priorities.heading: WAR WITH IRAN
